description: Implementation of ProductDao interface providing database access methods for Product entities, including retrieval by SEO URL, category, store, and other criteria, with complex JPA/Hibernate query construction.

classes.name: ProductDaoImpl
classes.description: Data Access Object implementation for Product entity, providing methods to retrieve products based on various filters such as store, category, locale, and SEO URL.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches a Product entity by its SEO URL within a merchant store, considering region and locale.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Returns a list of products available for a specific locale within store and category filters.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a distinct list of products belonging to specified category IDs.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products for specified categories with locale filtering.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns products associated with a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns products for a store with filtering based on product criteria.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Retrieves a product by ID specific to a locale, considering regional availability.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a full product entity by its unique ID, with associated descriptions and related objects.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a product by its SKU code for a specific language.
